description: Consensus review comments on pull requests contain broken Markdown links polluted with multi-line gh CLI hint text (for example 'hint: if you need to wait for this pull request ... gh event listen ...'). flow/github/pr.py create_or_update_pr returns only GhResult.output, which concatenates stdout and stderr, and flow/review/loop.py falls back to that string as pr_url whenever it starts with 'http', so a stderr hint block ends up inside the link target. gh_env in flow/github/adapter_runner.py disables only the docker CLI hints.
goal: create_or_update_pr returns an explicit, clean single-line pr_url parsed from the gh stdout only, so the existing consumer that prefers pr_res['pr_url'] never falls back to the combined output, and gh is spawned with its interactive prompts and update notifier switched off. The module line budgets are frozen: do not edit holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json or any budget-check script, and keep every touched module within its current budget.
rationale: The consumer in the review loop already prefers pr_res.get('pr_url') and only falls back to the combined output when it is absent, so fixing the producer removes the corruption without touching the review loop, which other work is changing.
acceptance_criteria: create_or_update_pr in flow/github/pr.py returns a 'pr_url' key holding the first https URL found on a line of the gh stdout (or None when stdout has none), in addition to the existing keys; the 'output' key is unchanged.

The pr_url never contains a newline, a 'hint:' line or any stderr text, even when gh writes a multi-line hint block on stderr after the URL on stdout; the error and not-attempted results carry pr_url None.
gh_env in flow/github/adapter_runner.py also sets GH_PROMPT_DISABLED=1 and GH_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1 while keeping DOCKER_CLI_HINTS=false and the existing proxy and environment merge order.

A new test file apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/github/test_pr_url.py covers a stdout URL plus a stderr hint block (create path), an edit path whose stdout has no URL, and the gh_env flags; it fails on the old code and passes on the new.
No other file changes: flow/review/loop.py, flow/github/adapter.py, the module budgets file and every budget-check script are untouched, and every touched module stays within its current line budget.
uv run pytest passes for apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/github, including the existing create_or_update_pr tests in test_review_post.py.
